items.title: My husband is happily retired at 64 and thinks I should keep working. Is he being fair?
items.excerpt: “I’m exhausted. My alarm goes off at 6 a.m., and I have a 50-minute commute.”

items.title: The FDA declined to approve one of biotech’s most closely watched cancer drugs
items.excerpt: The regulator told Summit Therapeutics that the lung-cancer drug needs to prove it can help people live longer.

items.title: My older brother, who has no children, cut our only sister out of his will. I’ll get everything instead. Do I tell her?
items.excerpt: “I’m torn between respecting my brother’s wishes and being fair to my sister.”

items.title: Parents told us what it’s like to help their kids battle sports-gambling addiction: ‘There’s no handbook’
items.excerpt: “We essentially married the most addictive device with the most addictive behavior, and we put them together.”

items.title: ‘It leaves me with a sour taste’: My elderly mother gave our cousin $800 for a car repair. Should I be worried?
items.excerpt: “I know older people can easily feel patronized, and I don’t want that to happen.”

items.title: Budget airlines are going upscale with first-class seats and faster wifi
items.excerpt: Forget no-frills: Frontier and JetBlue are chasing luxury flyers, and Wall Street is buying in.

items.title: I’m in my 40s. Should I accept a lower pension in exchange for naming my husband or child as a beneficiary?
items.excerpt: “If I die before my husband, he will receive a lifetime pension equal to 50%–66% of my monthly benefit.”

items.title: Nvidia is gearing up for one of Wall Street’s most anticipated earnings calls in years
items.excerpt: Jensen Huang’s sudden departure has made Tuesday’s earnings call “the most important in the company’s history.”

items.title: Why this 40-year market veteran is making a lonely bet on a 40% stock-market crash — and $500 oil
items.excerpt: Ulf Lindahl says a storm is brewing for investors in the U.S. stock market, who will also be facing $500 oil in a few years. Here is where he’d shelter.

items.title: How to use options to bet against Big Tech, while keeping risk in check
items.excerpt: One way to bet on the continued move away from Big Tech is by buying options that give you the right to both buy and sell certain market ETFs.
